description: Following the diagnostic AI poisoning incident, a grassroots movement of clinicians and software auditors forms 'MedVerify', an open-source coalition that reverse-engineers and stress-tests medical AI systems. It begins publishing high-impact vulnerability reports, forcing vendors into emergency patches and drawing public attention to the gap between regulatory approval and real-world robustness. The movement gains legitimacy after uncovering a flaw in a widely used radiology assistant, triggering national reviews in three countries.
